dedupe_keys.name: couverture mobile theorique en nouvelle caledonie

description: Couverture mobile théorique en Nouvelle-Calédonie is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Office des postes et télécommunications de Nouvelle-Calédonie (OPT-NC). Ce jeu de données présente la couverture théorique du réseau mobile sur le territoire de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Il provient de la plateforme Open Data SIG de l'OPT-NC, d'où il est directement téléchargeable. Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Technology, Digital, Science, Economy, Employment. Its keywords are mobile, mobilis, GSM, 3G, 4G, couverture. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/open-licence.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
